units.translation: Thus A. I. Ahrens for διμασε [he divided], which is in M (changed by Robortello to δόμοισι [in the houses], by Turnebus to δώμασι [in the houses]) with the letter o in an erasure, the verse being separated. The scholiast reads δόμοις [in the houses], interpreting it by οἴκοις [houses].
For thus Blomfield for δόμοις [in the houses].
before entering my house
the house mourns its husband, bereft
having come to the house of the Atreidae
he mowed down the ancestral house of the native-born
the house does not know how to be poor
the whole house did not sink
from a small one you might raise a great house
when the house is maddened by evils
grant to look upon the house of the man (I corrected ἀναδῦν [to emerge])
to the house of Agamemnon
sharing in every house
go to the house
whom would any house hold, polluting it from the roof?
the houses breathe blood-dripping murder
outside the houses and the fatherland
to remain inside the houses
champion of my houses
new toils of the houses
toils of the houses at the hearth
for the ruin of the houses
a piercing cry sends a loud wail from the houses to the ear
for I consider the eye of the house to be the presence of its master
I sent back from the houses
you praised him as he went from the houses
taking adornment from the houses
glory of the houses
prophets of the houses
a phantom will seem to rule over the houses
grief, stout-hearted, is fitting for each of the houses
having been consecrated from many houses
I am going to the halls of the houses
of the sins of these houses
disgrace of the houses
who could cast out the accursed offspring from the houses?
as he went from these houses
he drove him out from the city and the houses
I went, sent forth from the houses
dream-prophet of the houses
overthrowings of the houses
destroyer of the houses
having the same exile from the houses
grant power over your houses
from the ancestral houses
spear-friend of the houses
unwarmed hearth of the houses
into the hospitable men's halls of the houses
hope is gone from the houses
of the master's houses
we drive the matricides from the houses
we drive those who kill mortals from the houses
from the houses
for the houses and bodies
for my child and my houses
wealth sufficient for the houses
Artaphrenes, a noble man, killed him in the houses
to raise a shrill cry in the houses
it is most fitting that these things and Clytemnestra be a care to the houses
he would find a faithful wife in the houses
he reared a lion's whelp in the houses
some priest of ruin was reared in the houses
to sit in the houses, a desolate, terrible evil
shrieking in the houses
having been brought forth in the houses in oracles
cold is in the houses
since Zeus set you, without wrath, to be a partner in the lustral waters in the houses
in these houses he is plotting evil
the revel remains in the houses
these who sit upon the houses
about to wail in the houses
this man, having filled a mixing bowl of evils in the houses
who was then in the houses
a new calamity befalls the houses
for we consider enmity common in the houses
how shall we bring Orestes back to the houses?
leaving behind good repute in the houses
many torches were lit in the houses
a hateful marriage, abominable to the houses
who is within in the houses?
